flows.up1.foreign_taxed.quote: withholding tax at 10% or a lower applicable rate is imposed on dividends declared and payable to investors that are non-PRC tax resident enterprises
flows.up1.foreign_taxed.formula: the dividend is paid to a Hong Kong company and the Mainland levies withholding tax

flows.up1.foreign_headline_rate.quote: The provision for PRC Enterprise Income Tax is based on the estimated taxable income for the PRC taxation purposes at the applicable rate of 25%.

flows.up1.deductible_at_payer.formula: a dividend is a distribution of after-tax profit, not deductible by the payer (Enterprise Income Tax Law Article 10(1))

flows.up2.foreign_headline_rate.quote: The Hong Kong profit tax rate of our subsidiaries incorporated in Hong Kong is 16.5%.

flows.up2.deductible_at_payer.formula: a dividend is not a deductible outgoing for Hong Kong profits tax (s 16 of the Inland Revenue Ordinance allows only outgoings incurred in producing assessable profits)

present.HOLD.formula: the Company (Singapore) → (HK) Best China → (PRC) SH Anxin (pdf 44, 147): a Hong Kong intermediate holding company

present.financing.formula: each tier is an equity holding (pdf 44, 147); no intragroup loan disclosed

present.payment.basis: whether the dividend payment crosses years is not disclosed; payment in the same year is taken

event.on.basis: synthetic: 2026-06-30 (the prospectus period is 2023–2025; no dividend on this chain is disclosed)

event.dividend.quote: accumulated profits of the PRC subsidiaries amounting to S$20,668,000, S$29,103,000 and S$32,051,000
event.dividend.basis: SH Anxin's own profit is not disclosed; the Mainland subsidiaries' aggregate undistributed profits at end-2025 are S$32,051,000, and S$2,000,000 is taken as one dividend

event.onward.basis: the Hong Kong intermediate company passes the dividend it receives on in full to the Singapore parent

notes: Source: EKH Limited (2523.HK, incorporated in Singapore) prospectus of 2026-06-30 (cases/sources/K3-ekh-2026/source.pdf). K3 semi-synthetic: the chain and ratios come from the prospectus; the dividend amount and date are synthetic values.

Only one chain is modelled: the Company (Singapore, ULT) → Best China (Hong Kong investment holding, HOLD) → SH Anxin (Shanghai container depot, OP); the Gold Prime branch (half held through a BVI company) is not in this case.

Amounts are in Singapore dollars. Not disclosed, left for the program to ask: whether the Hong Kong company is a pure equity-holding entity, whether the dividends are remitted to Hong Kong and Singapore, the Singapore and Hong Kong tax residence certificates, the facts needed for the beneficial-owner determination.
